description: Check a webhook signature the way Last Price signs them: pass payload (the raw body, up to 8 KB), signature and secret, and optionally encoding (hex or base64) and prefix. Answers whether it is valid. Public and limited per address; use a test secret rather than a live one when you can, because the secret travels in the request. Needs no credential.

encoding.description: How the signature is encoded. Defaults to hex.

payload.description: The raw body the signature covers.

prefix.description: A prefix the signature carries, for example sha256=.

secret.description: The signing secret. Use a test secret where you can.

name: verify_webhook_signature
